intent: Make webapp and floating PWA profile consume one versioned semantic runtime contract, expose all and only currently user-readable/governable abstractions, and distinguish saved configuration from cycle-bound configuration effect without blocking the canonical TURN.

runtime_contract.stable_mode: optimistic before/after revision vector with one retry
runtime_contract.running_mode: nonblocking work overlay over last stable snapshot

config_effect.capture_boundary: after canonical frame sealing and before exact ACK
config_effect.reason: delegate TURN serialization has completed and pending exact ACK blocks configuration mutation; a pre-TURN read would be race-prone

modeled_falsification.claim_boundary: deterministic coverage of the declared S16 fault vocabulary; not empirical production reliability and not ten million browser executions

architecture_saturation.minimality_bound: unique only inside the declared 16-intervention S16 design vocabulary

executable_oracles.real_http_concurrency: ThreadingHTTPServer + authenticated pairing + synchronous slow TURN + concurrent /api/v10/surface + SEALED/ACK/DELIVERED
executable_oracles.reason_new_chromium_not_claimed: the attempted connector write for the Chromium extension was blocked; no nonexistent evidence is promoted into the contract

falsification_discoveries.finding: A global snapshot lock would serialize /api/v10/surface behind a synchronous TURN and regress S15bis liveness.
falsification_discoveries.resolution: nonblocking RUNNING overlay over a stable snapshot

falsification_discoveries.finding: Capturing experiment config before shell_command is race-prone and can bind the wrong revision if configuration wins before canonical TURN serialization.
falsification_discoveries.resolution: capture after sealed canonical frame while pending exact ACK prevents config mutation

falsification_discoveries.finding: Independent semantic pollers can observe different cycles/revisions even when each endpoint is locally correct.
falsification_discoveries.resolution: client compatibility virtualization over one versioned /api/v10/surface snapshot
